title: Angry complaint from a VIP
description: Negative sentiment and a chargeback threat: escalated to the human queue with high priority, with an empathetic holding reply.

ticket.subject: THIRD email about my espresso machine
ticket.body: This is the THIRD time I'm writing about order #1048. The espresso machine was supposed to arrive two weeks ago, tracking hasn't moved in 10 days and nobody answers. This is completely unacceptable for a $1,299 machine and honestly the worst service I've had. Sort it out or I will dispute the charge with my bank.
